text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон and Нарита Брайан really ran
their
hearts out.
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but still... Нарита Брайан is on a
completely
different level, even though
she didn't get first.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
I don't know how to say it, but she's so
intense!
She's a total beast!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Dang it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I gave it my best shot! My runnin' was
nothing
short of perfect! And yet...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
(My emotions lost out against Narita
Brian's own
spirit and drive!)
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Argh! This sucks!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to the Shuka Sho, Hishi
Amazon
leaves the track without any
post-race interviews.

She tells me she's going to pack her stuff
and
head back early, and then she's
gone.
She's tough, but still...

I know how long she waited for this
race... and
how high the stakes were.

My worries get the better of me, and I
rush back
to the academy to go find her.
Grrraaaah!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm greeted by the sound of a familiar
voice the
moment I reach campus.
Huff... Puff...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I still don't have what it takes! And so
what?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I can always keep runnin'! I'll blast right
past 'em
all!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You never know how a race'll turn out
till you run
it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She charges up the incline, shouting
words of
encouragement to herself.

Nothing out there is impossible right
from the
get-go!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You never know the outcome of a match
till you
give it a try!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Pant... Phew!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She said those very same things to me
before I
scouted her. It was her
straightforward honesty
that won me
over.

No matter the situation she must
contend with,
she remains stalwart and
isn't afraid to keep
going.

There's only one thing I can say to
someone as
strong as her.
Okay, one more time!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Wha?! Teach, when did you get here?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Let's give the Arima Kinen another go next year!

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is sure to show up at the
Arima Kinen
next year.

I tell Хиши Амадзон that we'll win next
time, for
sure. If anyone can do it, it's
her!
Teach, you...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yeah! Thanks!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, we discuss our next steps.

Considering the aptitude she showed for
miles
and medium-distance races during
the Tiara
tour...

We decide to make our next goal the
Osaka Hai,
followed by the Yasuda
Kinen!

Hey, Teach? This could be my ego
talking, but...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get first place in both of 'em. I
won't
settle for less!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I've gotta step up to the challenge.
Otherwise, I
won't have a chance against
Нарита Брайан. She's
one heck of a beast.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Together, we vow to win first place in
both races!
